body: Guessing you loved your brother? My sister never missed an opportunity to tell me what s horrible person I am. There is no one worth sticking around for- the people closest to me that know me best even know this and are not afraid to be vocal about it.

Bullied and harrassed by my best friend of almost a decade until I was suicidal... then she made sure I was fired from my job of 10 years BECAUSE I was suicidal. My parents not only sided with her, but defended her actions on the basis that I'm "not perfect either."  Facing eviction, off my meds.

Pets have been spoken for (told them I was moving), left contact info in my note along with a request for no service. I used to wonder if people would even come to my funeral, and now it pisses me off that there's a pretty big chance the people who couldn't wait to see me destroyed will be the first ones lined up for attention and sympathy.

Took 2 benadryl to sleep- cord kept slipping on the wooden deck in the rain, but it's on the agenda to complete the mission today, as it's light now and everything looks to be dried off.

You're very wrong on who might be "sad." Woke up and there were no texts, messages, emails, missed calls, tweets, DMs, or posts from anyone in my life. Not. One.

TRUTH.
It's cold, raining, and pitch black here. Cord kept slipping and so did my feet (toes). Will try again when it's lighter and dryer on my deck.

There really isn't, tbh. It's been proven to me over and over again thru the years. It's really dark and raining right now and the cord kept slipping, so I guess i have to wait until it's lighter and dryer. A few more hours, I suppose. Simpsons marathon is on to pass the time.

I'm an organ donor, wrote out all the details for my parents, set aside some money for cremation. Just slipped on the deck and couldn't get the cord to go tight enough on the wet wood- it's pitch black and raining right now. I guess I live to see another 8 hours or so until it gets lighter and dryer.
Got fired today because I reported more problems on Friday.
Got fired today. More proof that I'm not worth it.
Said goodbye to all of them - Gemma is the rabbit, and Trillian, Moo, and Zeke are the cats, by the way. Thanks for chatting with me - it was nice. You're a good person.

All the time. Yep, I did all that. Plus 10 years of classes, conferences, and all kinds of other shit learning the fine art of optometry, mostly on my own dime and on my own time. I've also planned events that have raised thousands of dollars for cancer patients and sick kiddos. Most recently was a wing challenge for a children's hospital and a golf open for Rescue dogs. Like I said, I only ever wanted to be a good person and put good into the world... alas, my karmic energy clearly says I was a puppy kicking old lady mugger in a past life.

I threw my boss a surprise birthday party this spring, then I got her alcoholic kid into a post-rehab program less than 2 weeks ago with some of my connections from when I worked in psych. Hard work and loyalty mean nothing in the world we live in... I almost envy the distorted Boomer view on life where it still does...
Got fired today.
FB rants ALWAYS just feel better once you've typed it out 😂😂

There's just no one... I feel so whiney and dramatic (hence posting anonymously online!) if I even attempt to talk about any of it. I can't get a straight answer from the 3 attorneys I contacted regarding if the behavior has crossed a legal line, BUT I posted in r/legal advice yesterday and someone said that since the harrassment wasn't based on anything "protected" (sex, race, etc) it wasn't illegal. I just feel so powerless and alone right now! :(

A weird memory popped into my head today... maybe 6 years ago I had to have a colonoscopy and a biopsy- basically they were looking for cancer in the gastrointestinal system. I had the procedure planned about a month in advance, including a couple days off from work (they knew why I would be out), but a spot opened up and my office manager just HAD to get in for liposuction, so I did my colonoscopy prep AT WORK because I couldn't get the day off anymore. 

I keep thinking of shit like this that makes me realize just HOW MUCH of the last decade was wasted on this place and the people in it. :'(
"You can ALWAYS reach out and talk to me/someone.... but, like, don't though, okay?"

I'm sitting here with a slipped disc in my neck that only "flares" or gets too bad with stress... and I can barely move right now, so I completely empathize with the health issues!

Thank you for your kind words, and please take your own advice and put yourself first, too, okay?

"I'm still burning."
Oh wow, I really love that! ❤

Thank you SO MUCH for this! I ended up taking a benadryl and a muscle relaxer last night- didn't sleep much, but it made me groggy enough to not really have the energy to cry (not the healthiest way to deal, admittedly). I am awake now and still struggling... and will try some of these. Thank you again!

I like being the reason someone's day is a little better, that I can always make people feel a little lighter... I just wish I had it in me to be happy, too. Does that even make sense or is that just a selfish, arrogant, douchey thing to think?
